value.rationale: The natural genus-three split-quadric (2,4) model admits a sharp arithmetic constraint of no rational points. Classifying every smooth embedded solution reveals only three coordinate orbits, two ordinary and one nonordinary. The precise factorwise orbit structure and wild-ramification dichotomy make the finite count interpretable beyond the already known abstract existence result.
